properties.notes: Main constraints: Regenerating existing employment sites Local Plan Delivery Policy EI2 (ER6) and shape of site. Previous resolution to grant permission subject to conditions. Site investigation required. Summary: The site is considered to be deliverable for a range of uses including housing within five years. The site is available now and is designated in the Local Plan as an existing employment site suitable for regeneration for mixed use development including housing and employment.. This site could be developed for medium density housing typically comprising a mix of detached, semi -detached and terraced dwellings at an average density of around 35 dph, and the suggested yield for a residential scheme across the net developable area is 39 units.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
